steps.text: An item with 3 sockets and the runes to insert in order.
calc: sockets D1: kids[] = the children's class ids in socket order; s = stat 194 & 0xFF = the item's sockets = 3.

steps.text: Insert 1: 1 of 3 sockets filled, no match.
calc: sockets D1: s = 3, n = 1; s != n, return none.

steps.text: Insert 2: 2 of 3 sockets filled, no match.
calc: sockets D1: s = 3, n = 2; s != n, return none.

steps.text: The full item passes the quality, quest and count tests.
calc: sockets D1: quality 2 is outside 4..9 (u32 (quality - 4) < 6 returns none).
sockets D1: ItemRecord quest = 0; n = 3 = s.
sockets D2: for r in 0 ..< RunesCount: skip rows with complete = 0; while k < 6 and R.rune[k] >= 1, goto next on n < k or kids[k] != R.rune[k].
skipped before the hit, by the first differing rune: rune 1: 40, rune 2: 1.

steps.text: Record 41, Sanctuary: its runes equal the children in socket order.
calc: sockets D2: R.rune = ['KO', 'KO', 'MAL']; kids = ['KO', 'KO', 'MAL']; k reaches 3 >= s = 3.

steps.text: The item type fits the row.
calc: sockets D3: no excluded type of the row is the item's type.
sockets D4: ITEMS_UnitIsType(parent, itype) is true through SHIE -> SHLD, so the row is returned.
